craft_notes: Sthāyin: wall simile. Rows: ground then gate. Read aloud: foundation stone.

lines: For given the true's wall-like steadiness,
all this drawn fits, else not.
So by the mass alone causation befits.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pāramārthike hi bhittisthānīye sthite rūpe sarvam idam ullikhyamānaṃ ghaṭate na anyathā ata eva sāmagryā eva kāruṇatvaṃ yuktam
